problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 7 delivery routes through 7 distribution hubs.

Each route consists of a sequence of hub stops represented as (Hub, Service time) pairs,
where each pair specifies the hub where the stop must occur and the time required for service.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the hub stops must be visited.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (H4, 5) → (H5, 3) → (H1, 6) → (H3, 2) → (H2, 3) → (H6, 1) → (H7, 3)
* R2 requires the sequence: (H5, 2) → (H7, 8) → (H2, 9) → (H1, 6) → (H4, 6) → (H6, 2) → (H3, 1)
* R3 requires the sequence: (H2, 8) → (H7, 6) → (H4, 9) → (H3, 6) → (H6, 2) → (H1, 2) → (H5, 5)
* R4 requires the sequence: (H5, 5) → (H4, 4) → (H2, 8) → (H3, 6) → (H7, 5) → (H1, 7) → (H6, 10)
* R5 requires the sequence: (H2, 6) → (H1, 6) → (H4, 7) → (H3, 5) → (H5, 6) → (H7, 7) → (H6, 5)
* R6 requires the sequence: (H7, 6) → (H1, 4) → (H4, 3) → (H3, 6) → (H6, 8) → (H2, 4) → (H5, 2)
* R7 requires the sequence: (H6, 7) → (H4, 9) → (H7, 5) → (H5, 8) → (H3, 4) → (H2, 6) → (H1, 9)

Each hub stop must be completed without interruption once it begins,
and each distribution hub can only accommodate one delivery vehicle at a time.
The objective is to determine the service schedule for all hub stops across the distribution network
so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
